problem_statement: The CoAP client library has no way to deregister an active observe subscription that is kept alive in a request slot. An application that created an observe request (GET with the Observe option) has no means to notify the server to stop the observation before the internal slot is cleaned up. Add a client API that, given a request matching an ongoing observe subscription, sends a GET with the Observe option set to 1 (deregister, per RFC 7641 Section 3.6) using the same token as the original observe request, mirroring the confirmable/non-confirmable type of the original request. For a confirmable request the deregister is sent and retransmitted by the library, and the response callback is later invoked with the server's final response (2.05 Content); for a non-confirmable request the deregister is sent once and the request is released immediately, with the response callback invoked with -ECANCELED. Matching of the request to the ongoing observe subscription follows the same rules as cancelling a request.
